screening_answers: Success is measured by how well the model separates churners from non‑churners—key metrics include recall, precision, AUC‑ROC, and the lift in actual churn reduction. I compare against a baseline, track these metrics across experiments, and tie improvements to business outcomes such as retained revenue. In the Ironpath Foods project the recall rose to 0.54.

I would approach an NLP project by first cleaning and tokenizing the text, then applying pretrained language models (e.g., BERT) to generate contextual embeddings. A downstream classifier (logistic regression or gradient‑boosted trees) would be trained, with hyper‑parameter tuning and cross‑validation to ensure robustness. I would log each experiment, document preprocessing steps, and produce a short user guide for hand‑over.
